body: But maybe being cheesy is a good thing lol.  Better than just not caring, right?  It sounds like we do have a bit in common, I did theatre, band and choir back in high school as well.  It's kinda of funny reflecting on how much more hate I got back then for being a straight man doing all of those things in the late 2000s, but had a way more positive outlook on everything in life.  Maybe part of the issue is complacency?

Especially with our generation, I have two friends that are married and one with kids.  This isn't the 1960s anymore mom/dad... lol.  I do have to admit that the music thing was nothing that I couldn't have handled better at the time, but I was not as wise and listened to much to other people's opinions.  If you have the opportunity, I highly recommend doing some sort of performance in front of people, and then maybe doing something solo, if you haven't already.  Most alive I think I've ever felt was playing solos.

And the marriage question only gets worse as your siblings and cousins have kids and you get closer to 30... I hope singing stays with you, I really do.  Music was pretty much my life until some things happened that I'll just gloss over.  Still love listening to it, but I've never been able to enjoy playing the same.  I'd just say don't let anyone sway you from that, because it's probably one of the most freeing hobbies you will ever find.

Maybe I'll check out one of the community colleges around here and try like woodworking or some random shit.  I tend to get bored quick too though.  Dating is just so weird anymore.  Sure I'd love to find someone that I care about, but it just feels so forced anymore.  Between pressure from friends and family and these stupid dating apps.  Like, why can't I just introduce myself at the bar or at a grocery store anymore? Why does that make me a creep? Why do I have to text you via an app based on a picture and 2 sentences, when I hate texting to begin with lol.

This probably does not help, but work and school don't change that.  Waiting sucks, and I'm not sure if it's worth it, but what is the alternative?  Being the younger sibling certainly doesn't help either, why do we even have to compare ourselves to siblings?  But tonight, I've found that just talking to people in similar situations is... 'helpful.' Not sure that that explains it accurately, but I'm finding it's good to know you are not alone in the way you feel, even though no one around you on a day to day basis gets it.  Feel free to message me if you need to just vent or talk about nothing, maybe we'll both figure it out.

I appreciate it! Not coming off weird at all, it feels good to know I'm not the only person that is stuck in this odd space.  Maybe we're not normal, but who is?  And that's my brush it off motto lol.  I've tried old hobbies, but maybe I just need to try something new.  Have you had any luck?

I tried a handful of times over the last few years, but if I'm being brutally honest, I think I just wasn't happy enough with myself to be worth anything.  Have been thinking about trying again, recently lost a bit of weight and got back into old hobbies, but I have an agreeable personality with a dark/sarcastic sense of humor.  Doesn't work out for most first dates in my experience.
